title: 第11章 合欢宗话本精选集第12章 再次逃跑
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
“呃，那个……”她换了一套说辞，“不是买来的，是……是这把剑自愿跟着老婆子的。”
她停顿片刻，补充道：“真不是偷的，也不是抢的，是这把剑自己选的我。”
“不信的话，你们可以探我老婆子的修为，我只有筑基，怎么可能去天剑宗偷东西。”
说着，她将破云往外一丢，长剑飞出，中途忽然停住悬在半空，而后调转方向，悠悠飘回她身边，稳稳悬停在她右手边。
宁楚耸耸肩，睁着一双无辜的大眼盯着宁宝儿等人。
几人对视一眼，老人家并没说谎，她的修为确实很差。
裴昭：“宁楚死了，难不成这个老婆婆就是破云新认的主人？”
那破云的眼光也太差了吧。
宁宝儿深吸一口气，收剑入鞘，对其他师兄弟说：“把剑收起来。”
姜珊有些急，“可是……”
“本命剑不会认错主人。”宁宝儿打断了她，声音不大，但不容置疑，“破云选择了这位老人家，那她就是破云的主人。我们无权干涉。”
她转向宁楚，微微欠身，“老人家，抱歉，方才冒犯了。”
宁楚没想到她这么好说话，怔愣一瞬，连连摆手，“没事没事。”
她一边说一边后退，准备趁热打铁赶紧跑路。
但她刚退了半步，宁宝儿又开了口：“老人家。”
宁楚脚步一顿，直勾勾地盯着她。
“你也是要去玄华秘境的吗？就你一个人？”
玄华秘境，每五十年出现在浮生界一次，出现的地点随机刷新，她以前去过一次，里面有不少宝贝，灵气也充裕。
思及此，宁楚抬眸，目光在昏暗的密林里扫视一圈，看来秘境刷新在这附近了，宁宝儿他们也是要去秘境的。
她想去，可她的修为不允许。

“不瞒各位道友，老婆子这辈子的执念就是修仙。”她长叹一口气，声音凄凄惨惨戚戚，“可我实在没什么天赋，听闻玄华秘境现世，我想着能在死之前去看一眼秘境的大门也好。”
宁宝儿是所有人里最心软的那一个，闻言又抬手搀扶住她的胳膊，“老人家若不介意，不妨与我们一道同行，正好我们也要去秘境。”
姜珊连阻止都来不及，她已经把话说出了口。
宁楚眼眸一亮，“果真吗？”
她点点头，“自然是真的，不过今日天色已晚，我们先找个地方扎营休整，明日一早再出发吧。”
“好。”宁楚满口答应下来，极其谄媚道：“多谢几位道友，多谢。”
眼看宁宝儿自顾自搀扶着老人家抬腿就走，剩下的三人面面相觑，嘴角抽了抽。
顾玄取了妖兽的晶核放进储物袋，传音入密：我总觉得那老婆婆不太对劲，先留在身边，盯紧她。
姜珊：我也觉得。
裴昭直接捏碎一张传音符：哪有这么麻烦，直接问问小师叔不久行了，当初宗主可是亲手把破云交给小师叔保管的。
一行人选了个靠近水源的地方休整，宁宝儿还分出一支帐篷给宁楚。
她的温柔善良让宁楚自惭形秽，宁宝儿对谁都很好，但她从前却处处跟她作对，她可真不是人。
顾玄跟裴昭两人轮流守夜，宁楚带着富贵钻进帐篷里，终于有时间好好地看一眼破云。
content_en:
"Uh, um..." she changed her words, "I didn't buy it, it was... this sword followed the old woman voluntarily."
She paused for a moment and added: "I really didn't steal it or rob it. I chose this sword for myself."
"If you don't believe it, you can check my old lady's cultivation. I only have foundation building, how can I go to Tianjian Sect to steal things."
As she said that, she threw Poyun out, and the long sword flew out. It suddenly stopped and hung in mid-air, then turned around and floated back to her side, hovering steadily on her right side.
Ning Chu shrugged and stared at Ning Baoer and others with a pair of innocent eyes.
Several people looked at each other and saw that the old man was not lying. Her cultivation was indeed very poor.
Pei Zhao: "Ning Chu is dead, is it possible that this old woman is Poyun's new master?"
Poyun's vision must be too bad.
Ning Baoer took a deep breath, sheathed his sword, and said to the other brothers: "Put the sword away."
Jiang Shan was a little anxious, "But..."
"The natal sword will never recognize its wrong owner." Ning Baoer interrupted her, her voice was not loud, but there was no room for doubt, "Poyun has chosen this old man, then she is Poyun's owner. We have no right to interfere."
She turned to Ning Chu and bowed slightly, "Old man, I'm sorry, I just offended you."
Ning Chu didn't expect her to be so easy to talk to. She was stunned for a moment and waved her hands repeatedly, "It's okay, it's okay."
As she spoke, she backed away, ready to strike while the iron was hot and run away.
But just as she took half a step back, Ning Baoer spoke again: "Old man."
Ning Chu paused and stared at her.
"Are you going to the Xuanhua Secret Realm too? Are you alone?"
The Xuanhua Secret Realm appears in the floating world every fifty years, and the location where it appears is randomly refreshed. She has been there once before. There are many treasures in it and there is plenty of spiritual energy.
Thinking of this, Ning Chu raised his eyes and glanced around the dark forest. It seemed that the secret realm had been refreshed nearby, and Ning Baoer and the others were also going to the secret realm.
She wanted to go, but her cultivation didn't allow it.
"To be honest with you fellow Taoists, my lifelong obsession is to cultivate immortality." She sighed, her voice pitiful, "But I really don't have any talent. When I heard that the Xuanhua Secret Realm appeared, I thought it would be good to take a look at the gate of the secret realm before I die."
Ning Bao'er was the softest one among all the people. Hearing this, he raised his hand to support her arm, "If you don't mind, old man, you might as well come with us. It just so happens that we are also going to the secret realm."
Jiang Shan didn't even have time to stop her, she had already spoken out.
Ning Chu's eyes lit up, "Is it true?"
She nodded, "Of course it's true, but it's getting late today. Let's find a place to camp and rest, and then set off early tomorrow morning."
"Okay." Ning Chu agreed and said extremely flatteringly: "Thank you fellow Taoists, thank you very much."
Seeing Ning Baoer minding his own business, helping the old man lift his legs and leaving, the remaining three looked at each other with twitching corners of their mouths.
Gu Xuan took the crystal core of the monster and put it into the storage bag, and transmitted the message into the secret: I always feel that something is wrong with that old woman, so I will stay with her and keep an eye on her.
Jiang Shan: I think so too.
Pei Zhao directly crushed a transmission talisman: Why is it so troublesome? Just ask the junior uncle for a while. The sect leader personally gave Poyun to the junior uncle for safekeeping.
The group of people chose a place near the water source to rest, and Ning Baoer even gave Ning Chu a tent.
Her gentleness and kindness made Ning Chu feel ashamed. Ning Baoer was kind to everyone, but she always opposed her in the past. She was really not a human being.
Gu Xuan and Pei Zhao took turns keeping vigil. Ning Chu took Fugui into the tent and finally had time to take a good look at Po Yun.
